title: Unwrapped Flesh
description:
Unwrapped Flesh presents a translucent membrane suspended over an altered anatomy. Informed by the lines of Blaschko,* the seams articulated across its surface reveal the concealed logic of its formation, translating an internal developmental system into visible form. The membrane emerges not as an external covering, but as a second skin generated by the altered organism itself.

* Alfred Blaschko (1858-1922)
A German dermatologist who, in 1901, mapped the normally imperceptible pattern of developmental pathways within human skin, made visible through differences between epidermal cell populations.
